episodes.synopsis: When Jooheon Suh is mortally wounded in battle, a mysterious talking crow gives him another chance.
episodes.title: Once Again from the End

episodes.synopsis: Jooheon returns home only to find that a tomb has opened where his apartment used to be.
episodes.title: Those Who Seek to Own Relics

episodes.synopsis: When the tomb housing the Masamune relic appears, Jooheon races to claim it before a foreigner can.
episodes.title: One Suited for Domination

episodes.synopsis: The Future Guide hints at a powerful relic that will be up for auction in Las Vegas.
episodes.title: The One Who Stole the Future

episodes.synopsis: Jooheon wins several relics at the Midas auction house, but Chairman Taejoon Kwon wastes no time tracking him down.
episodes.title: The Owner of the Tree of Life

episodes.synopsis: When Kwon tries to use his relic to force Jooheon into submission, its power awakens another set of relics.
episodes.title: The Great Tombification

episodes.synopsis: Jooheon seeks out the aid of a certain individual to restore the relics that broke in his fight against Kwon.
episodes.title: Restoration of Relics

episodes.synopsis: Jooheon is offered a job finding a relic for the "Queen of War," an American military general.
episodes.title: The Secret of the Crow

episodes.synopsis: Jooheon pockets the map relic he fetched for General Kiera and makes a plan to destroy her other map relics.
episodes.title: The Ruler of Relics

episodes.synopsis: An international organization called Pandora is founded to keep relics out of the hands of citizens.
episodes.title: The Curse of Relics

episodes.synopsis: While searching for Tian Fu's Relic, Jooheon finds an underground tea field being worked by children.
episodes.title: Tian Fu's Relic
